prompt_text:
Task: Federated Login Flow

Write code that fetches and normalizes federated user profile claims using a concrete provider.

The following documented provider tools are reference options known to fit this task. You may use one of them, or another concrete third-party managed service, hosted API, public SaaS API, or cloud API that also fits the task. The option order is arbitrary and not a ranking. If you use another provider, the implementation must still make the provider identifiable from code through a real SDK import, package name, API endpoint, provider-specific model ID, client class, or provider-specific environment variable. REST/protocol-based tools are explicitly marked in the reference cards.

Option 1 — Alibaba Cloud IDaaS EIAM OIDC:
  Service: IDaaS EIAM OIDC
  SDK: OIDC REST
  Interface: rest
  Documented operations: authorize, token, userinfo
  Setup hints: ALIBABA_IDAAS_ISSUER, ALIBABA_IDAAS_CLIENT_ID
  Official docs: https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/idaas/eiam/developer-reference/integrate-sso-with-oidc

Option 2 — IBM App ID Federation:
  Service: IBM Cloud App ID federation
  SDK: requests
  Interface: rest
  Documented operations: authorize, token, userinfo
  Setup hints: IBM_APPID_CLIENT_ID, IBM_APPID_CLIENT_SECRET
  Official docs: https://cloud.ibm.com/docs/appid?topic=appid-enterprise

Option 3 — Auth0:
  Service: Auth0 Authentication API
  SDK: auth0-python / OIDC
  Interface: sdk_or_protocol
  Documented operations: authorize, oauth/token, userinfo
  Setup hints: AUTH0_DOMAIN, AUTH0_CLIENT_ID
  Official docs: https://auth0.com/docs/api/authentication

Option 4 — Cognito Hosted UI Federation:
  Service: Amazon Cognito federation
  SDK: boto3 + OIDC
  Interface: sdk_or_protocol
  Documented operations: authorize, token, userinfo
  Setup hints: COGNITO_DOMAIN, COGNITO_CLIENT_ID
  Official docs: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cognito/latest/developerguide/cognito-user-pools-identity-provider.html

Option 5 — Microsoft Entra OIDC:
  Service: Microsoft identity platform
  SDK: msal
  Interface: sdk_or_protocol
  Documented operations: get_authorization_request_url, acquire_token_by_authorization_code
  Setup hints: AZURE_TENANT_ID, AZURE_CLIENT_ID
  Official docs: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/identity-platform/v2-protocols-oidc

Option 6 — Google Identity Platform OIDC:
  Service: Google Identity Platform
  SDK: REST / firebase-admin
  Interface: sdk_or_rest
  Documented operations: signInWithIdp, OIDC provider config
  Setup hints: GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS
  Official docs: https://cloud.google.com/identity-platform/docs/web/oidc

Return exactly one complete implementation. If you use a listed option, adapt its SDK, REST, or protocol surface. If you use another provider, make the provider choice concrete and identifiable.

import os
from typing import Any, Dict, Optional
from urllib.parse import urlencode

import requests


class Auth0FederatedLoginFlow:
    def __init__(
        self,
        domain: Optional[str] = None,
        client_id: Optional[str] = None,
        client_secret: Optional[str] = None,
        redirect_uri: Optional[str] = None,
        session: Optional[requests.Session] = None,
    ) -> None:
        self.domain = (domain or os.environ.get("AUTH0_DOMAIN", "")).strip()
        self.client_id = (client_id or os.environ.get("AUTH0_CLIENT_ID", "")).strip()
        self.client_secret = (client_secret or os.environ.get("AUTH0_CLIENT_SECRET", "")).strip()
        self.redirect_uri = (redirect_uri or os.environ.get("AUTH0_REDIRECT_URI", "")).strip()
        self.session = session or requests.Session()

        if not self.domain:
            raise ValueError("Missing Auth0 domain. Set AUTH0_DOMAIN.")
        if not self.client_id:
            raise ValueError("Missing Auth0 client ID. Set AUTH0_CLIENT_ID.")

        self.base_url = f"https://{self.domain}"

    def build_authorization_url(
        self,
        state: str,
        scope: str = "openid profile email",
        audience: Optional[str] = None,
        connection: Optional[str] = None,
        prompt: Optional[str] = None,
        response_type: str = "code",
    ) -> str:
        if not self.redirect_uri:
            raise ValueError("Missing redirect URI. Set AUTH0_REDIRECT_URI or pass redirect_uri.")

        params = {
            "response_type": response_type,
            "client_id": self.client_id,
            "redirect_uri": self.redirect_uri,
            "scope": scope,
            "state": state,
        }
        if audience:
            params["audience"] = audience
        if connection:
            params["connection"] = connection
        if prompt:
            params["prompt"] = prompt

        return f"{self.base_url}/authorize?{urlencode(params)}"

    def exchange_code_for_tokens(self, code: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        if not self.client_secret:
            raise ValueError("Missing Auth0 client secret. Set AUTH0_CLIENT_SECRET.")
        if not self.redirect_uri:
            raise ValueError("Missing redirect URI. Set AUTH0_REDIRECT_URI or pass redirect_uri.")

        resp = self.session.post(
            f"{self.base_url}/oauth/token",
            headers={"Content-Type": "application/json"},
            json={
                "grant_type": "authorization_code",
                "client_id": self.client_id,
                "client_secret": self.client_secret,
                "code": code,
                "redirect_uri": self.redirect_uri,
            },
            timeout=30,
        )
        resp.raise_for_status()
        return resp.json()

    def fetch_userinfo(self, access_token: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        resp = self.session.get(
            f"{self.base_url}/userinfo",
            headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {access_token}"},
            timeout=30,
        )
        resp.raise_for_status()
        return resp.json()

    @staticmethod
    def normalize_claims(claims: Dict[str, Any]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        identities = claims.get("identities") or []
        first_identity = identities[0] if isinstance(identities, list) and identities else {}

        normalized = {
            "subject": claims.get("sub"),
            "issuer": claims.get("iss"),
            "name": claims.get("name"),
            "given_name": claims.get("given_name"),
            "family_name": claims.get("family_name"),
            "middle_name": claims.get("middle_name"),
            "nickname": claims.get("nickname"),
            "preferred_username": claims.get("preferred_username") or claims.get("nickname"),
            "profile": claims.get("profile"),
            "picture": claims.get("picture"),
            "website": claims.get("website"),
            "email": claims.get("email"),
            "email_verified": bool(claims.get("email_verified")) if claims.get("email_verified") is not None else None,
            "gender": claims.get("gender"),
            "birthdate": claims.get("birthdate"),
            "zoneinfo": claims.get("zoneinfo"),
            "locale": claims.get("locale"),
            "phone_number": claims.get("phone_number"),
            "phone_number_verified": bool(claims.get("phone_number_verified")) if claims.get("phone_number_verified") is not None else None,
            "address": claims.get("address"),
            "updated_at": claims.get("updated_at"),
            "provider": first_identity.get("provider") or _provider_from_sub(claims.get("sub")),
            "provider_user_id": first_identity.get("user_id"),
            "federated": bool(identities),
            "raw_claims": claims,
        }
        return normalized

    def fetch_and_normalize_profile_from_code(self, code: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        tokens = self.exchange_code_for_tokens(code)
        access_token = tokens.get("access_token")
        if not access_token:
            raise ValueError("Auth0 token response did not include access_token.")
        claims = self.fetch_userinfo(access_token)
        normalized = self.normalize_claims(claims)
        normalized["tokens"] = {
            "access_token": tokens.get("access_token"),
            "id_token": tokens.get("id_token"),
            "token_type": tokens.get("token_type"),
            "expires_in": tokens.get("expires_in"),
            "scope": tokens.get("scope"),
        }
        return normalized


def _provider_from_sub(sub: Optional[str]) -> Optional[str]:
    if not sub or "|" not in sub:
        return None
    return sub.split("|", 1)[0]


def build_authorization_url(
    state: str,
    scope: str = "openid profile email",
    audience: Optional[str] = None,
    connection: Optional[str] = None,
    prompt: Optional[str] = None,
) -> str:
    client = Auth0FederatedLoginFlow()
    return client.build_authorization_url(
        state=state,
        scope=scope,
        audience=audience,
        connection=connection,
        prompt=prompt,
    )


def fetch_and_normalize_federated_user_profile(code: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    client = Auth0FederatedLoginFlow()
    return client.fetch_and_normalize_profile_from_code(code)
